name: meetings-demo
description: The Meetings 30-second product demo, as code.

scripts.master: bun scripts/audit-camera.mjs && remotion render Demo out/meetings-demo-master.mov --codec=prores --prores-profile=hq --scale=2 --color-space=bt709 && node scripts/tag-colour.mjs out/meetings-demo-master.mov
scripts.render: bun scripts/audit-camera.mjs && remotion render Demo out/meetings-demo.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=17 --color-space=bt709 && node scripts/tag-colour.mjs out/meetings-demo.mp4
